title: Remove the csound Python override — the ebuild may support the profile's Python now
body_lines: `media-sound/csound python_single_target_python3_13` in `package.use/00-profile-defaults`
was added because the csound ebuild only supported Python 3.12 and 3.13 while the
profile's default is 3.14, which left its REQUIRED_USE unsatisfied.
A csound ebuild **now appears to support Python 3.14**.
Please verify and remove the override line, here and on the machines.

title: Remove the a2jmidid Python override — the ebuild may support the profile's Python now
body_lines: `media-sound/a2jmidid python_single_target_python3_13` in `package.use/00-profile-defaults`
was added because the a2jmidid ebuild only supported Python up to 3.13 while the
profile's default is 3.14, which left its REQUIRED_USE unsatisfied.
An a2jmidid ebuild **now appears to support Python 3.14**.
Please verify and remove the override line, here and on the machines.

title: Remove musescore -jack workaround — REQUIRED_USE constraint may no longer exist
body_lines: The `-jack` USE flag on `media-sound/musescore` in `package.use/00-profile-defaults`
was added because musescore has `REQUIRED_USE="?? ( jack pipewire )"` (at most one of the two)
and both flags are globally enabled in `make.conf`.
`media-sound/musescore` **no longer appears to have the `?? ( jack pipewire )` constraint**.
Please verify and remove the `media-sound/musescore -jack` line, here and on the machines.

title: Remove faac MPEG-4 license workaround — dependency may no longer exist
body_lines: The MPEG-4 license acceptance for `media-libs/faac` in `package.license/00-binhost`
was added because `media-libs/avidemux-plugins[aac]` depends on `media-libs/faac`,
which is masked by the MPEG-4 license under `ACCEPT_LICENSE="-* @FREE @BINARY-REDISTRIBUTABLE"`.
`media-libs/avidemux-plugins` **no longer appears to depend on `media-libs/faac`**.
Please verify and remove the `media-libs/faac MPEG-4` line from `package.license/00-binhost`
and the `media-libs/faac` line from `config/no-publish.txt`.
